learning_extracted: e2_world_forward context is a confirmed prerequisite for CRF differentiation -- raw z_world is too self-similar (mint-block collapses the pool to ~2 rules).
Differentiation and persistence are in tension under the match-triggered-EMA availability scheme: solving differentiation (via e2ctx) worsens activity because narrowly-tuned rules match sparsely.

The next binding constraint is availability MAINTENANCE under sparse matching (a PFC sustained-activity / activity-silent analog), not the conflict-gate theta; the 654b theta retune addressed the wrong constraint for the differentiated regime.

Ground the maintenance mechanism in biology first -- the persistent-firing vs activity-silent fork determines whether the fix is a sustained-activity term or a redefinition of the 'active fraction' readout.
